The main takeaway from our work is that
the antigenic properties of T3 phage proteins are not constant and may change in the course of the phage evolution.
non-classical modification is not a simple DNA modification but rather a complex phenomenon involving changes in the structure and antigenic properties of the adsorption protein of the phage.
the host range mutant of the phage T3, T3hW, is not a single phage but a mixture of phages with different modifications of the phage protein responsible for adsorption.
